title: Mamdani Hosted a Town Hall About Buses. Why Was the D.S.A. There?
summary: After Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s office invited the Democratic Socialists of America to a city-sponsored event, watchdog groups raised concerns about mixing politics with government work.
